Happy afternoon evening crew,
This morning, our head trainer brought up a concern about welfare walks

Thank you for keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk steady and attentive during a busy period. I want to reinforce that our role is to keep guidance clear, our tone calm, and our follow-through consistent so that travelers feel supported before departure and throughout the journey. When animal care questions arise, please respond with the same measured professionalism you have shown in recent weeks, and route anything uncertain through the proper operational channel rather than leaving it unresolved.

For the current welfare reminder, please keep the briefings practical and reassuring, especially when speaking with travelers who are anxious about crate preparation, handover steps, or cabin monitoring expectations. <<FACT F075>> We should continue to document any concerns carefully, share only verified guidance, and keep the communication concise enough that the traveler can act on it without confusion. Our cabin team remains attentive in flight, and that visibility should be reflected in the confidence of our messages.

Please also remember that crate review must be exact for smaller animals. <<FACT F062>> <<FACT F068>> If a case does not align cleanly with the published guidance, pause the process and escalate it at once so that we protect both animal welfare and service consistency. Thank you for your steady work, your respectful communication, and your willingness to keep Aurelia Skyways aligned with a calm, dependable standard.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
